_about.models_root: The folder your model folders usually live in. It is matched against the brands' modelsRoot in ~/.nexus-local/accounts.json to find the brand; accounts.json is written by the Content Board app, never by this skill.
_about.content_folder: The folder with your real print photos: inside each project folder in a brand with itemLayout 2 (the project whose pieces link the model), inside each model folder in a brand with itemLayout 1.
